categories.main_business_segments: TopBuild operates in two main business segments: Installation and Specialty Distribution. The Installation segment provides insulation installation services and other building products, while the Specialty Distribution segment distributes insulation, insulation accessories, and related building materials to contractors and dealers. Installation accounted for approximately 59% of 2022 sales, and Specialty Distribution for about 41%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TopBuild's core offerings are based on the installation and distribution of various insulation products, including fiberglass batts and rolls, blown-in loose fill fiberglass, polyurethane spray foam, and cellulose. The company manages the full installation process, from material procurement to quality assurance, and leverages building science expertise through its Environments for Living® program. Distribution operations focus on efficient logistics and supply chain management, supported by centralized purchasing and IT systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: TopBuild serves a diversified customer base, including national and regional single-family homebuilders, custom builders, multi-family builders, commercial/industrial general contractors, remodelers, individual homeowners, and insulation contractors of all sizes. Its end markets are primarily residential new construction, residential repair/remodel, and commercial/industrial construction and maintenance.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates approximately 230 installation branches and 179 specialty distribution centers across the United States, with an additional 17 distribution centers in Canada. Its operations are geographically diverse, allowing it to serve customers nationwide and in key Canadian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: TopBuild operates both downstream and midstream in the supply chain. It acts as a specialty distributor (midstream) supplying contractors and dealers, and as an installer (downstream) delivering finished installation services directly to end customers in the construction industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: TopBuild's strategic priorities include expanding market share in residential and commercial/industrial end markets, acquiring strategically aligned businesses, leveraging technology for operational efficiency, and driving productivity. The company emphasizes continuous improvement, innovation in building science, and operational excellence, with a focus on safety, talent development, and customer-centric solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through installation services (recognized over time as performance obligations are satisfied) and product sales through specialty distribution (recognized at the point of transfer of control). The company also offers value-added services such as energy efficiency consulting and building science programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TopBuild competes in a highly fragmented and competitive market, facing national, regional, and local insulation contractors, specialty insulation distributors, broad-line building products distributors, big box retailers, and insulation manufacturers. The company is a market leader in both installation and specialty distribution, leveraging its scale, geographic reach, and strong supplier relationships to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, TopBuild reported net sales of $5.0 billion, a 43.7% increase over 2021, driven by acquisitions, higher selling prices, and increased volume. Net income was $556 million, with strong operating margins and cash flow. The company has demonstrated significant growth through both organic expansion and strategic acquisitions, with a robust liquidity position and ongoing investment in its business.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TopBuild differentiates itself through its dual-channel model (installation and distribution), national scale, strong local presence, and expertise in building science and energy efficiency. Its ability to serve a broad range of customers, maintain supply chain reliability, and offer value-added services positions it as a trusted partner for builders and contractors seeking quality, efficiency, and innovation.
